prose: Lindsey Scharmyn (host of the Rogue Ways podcast) joined me for an analysis of the revamped tarot card images hidden in the game Cyberpunk 2077. This is not a plot breakdown or game-related show, but instead a look at the synchromystic message from the archetypes contained in this "transhuman tarot." The episode makes for a great tutorial on the themes found in tarot, astrology, and the universal hero's journey.
ext: Our analysis carries through to the halfway point of the major arcana.
